surat.headline: Diamond exports and demand rally while textile trading faces fires, fraud, and inflation slowdown.
what_changed: Diamond processing units shortened Diwali breaks to 7 days amid rising pre-Christmas demand, while Kira announced tripling LGD output to 750,000 carats monthly.
Surat textile units reopened post-Diwali, but local markets reported retail slowdown driven by consumer inflation.
Input costs eased for synthetic textiles with polyester FDY and staple fibre falling 6.96% and 4.33% respectively.
Textile infrastructure suffered two fire incidents alongside a reported 43.54 lakh grey fabric default/fraud.
stress_signals: Veer Creation operators fled with grey fabric, cheating Surat textile traders of 43.54 lakh rupees [e15e6b4c5b22].
Rising inflation has dampened consumer retail buying, creating a market slowdown and distress for textile traders [0fed4a76da43].
Operational disruption from fires in a building housing textile units and an ongoing 32-hour blaze at a textile godown [47888fb89bb1, 70735ded426a].
Lab-grown diamond proliferation continues to pressure natural diamond prices and secondary resale markets [3d642383c7eb].
improvement_signals: G&J exports rose 34.01% ahead of Christmas; GJEPC reported a 96% surge in LGD exports and 19% growth in natural diamond exports [c3b68570a07d, ffee544acb58].
Diamond units curtailed Diwali vacations from 25 days down to 7 days due to market demand surges [20dc10f35062].
Raw material relief for synthetic weavers as polyester FDY dropped 6.96% and staple fibre fell 4.33% on declining crude oil and freight [b6b6f83da93a].
what_to_watch: Grey fabric trade credit discipline and receivable aging across weaver and trader accounts following the fraud incident.
Inventory damage and insurance claim settlements for textile units impacted by godown and commercial building fires.
Price realization trends and working capital limits in natural diamond polishing units facing ongoing price pressure from expanding LGD capacity.
Developments regarding Surat weavers' demand to shift yarn administration from the Chemicals Ministry to the Ministry of Textiles.
